rationale: Public-alpha launch is currently blocked by operations posture, public exposure, release checks, and manual approval.
Provider expansion is useful but is not the next launch-track blocker.
The public alpha must remain read-only and must not enable live source fanout.
conditions_to_resume_provider_work: A concrete release or launch gate requires provider wiring before public alpha.
The operator changes the objective away from launch-track closeout.
Post-launch corpus/source growth becomes the next approved track.
protected_non_goals: no AI or provider output promoted as product truth
